Anna: quick Q  gateway config: proto-first or rest-first?
Ben: proto-first for typed safety; transcode at edge for browser clients, but avoid bidi in transcode.
Carlos: +1. limit transcode to unary and server-stream; bidi is a different beast.
Elaine: where to enforce quotas? centralized gateway gives early rejection; runtime gives accurate token accounting. both have tradeoffs.
Frank: telemetry needs: x-rw-route, x-rw-quota, x-request-id. also document HTTP -> gRPC status mapping.
deploy-bot: deploy gateway-transcode v0.3 canary -> eng-platform (5%)
Anna: action items: Carlos prototyping transcode (2w), Ben drafts telemetry header contract + console mock (1w), Frank inventories quota enforcement options (1w). meet Tue to align.
